fetch_account_usage: fetch account usage limits for a specified provider like openai-codex, anthropic, or openrouter
render_account_usage_lines: render an AccountUsageSnapshot into a list of human-readable usage lines with optional markdown formatting
create_AccountUsageSnapshot: create an AccountUsageSnapshot dataclass with provider, plan, usage windows, and availability status
create_AccountUsageWindow: create an AccountUsageWindow dataclass with label, used percentage, reset time, and detail text
fetch_anthropic_usage: fetch Anthropic OAuth account usage including session and weekly utilization for Opus and Sonnet models
